hx_expand_region — 2D halcon_ext op

• Data kinds: region → region

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "hx_expand_region", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: expand_region (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

Fill the gaps between regions (region -> region): dilate the binary region to encourage them to connect.

Treats v > 0.5 as the region, applies binary_dilation 1 time with the diamond obtained by iterating a 4-neighbourhood cross structuring element it times (Manhattan distance up to it), and returns a 0/1 float array.

• a → dilation radius it = 1 + int(a*4) (1 to 5 pixels). Regions whose mutual distance is 2*it pixels or less get connected.

• b is unused.

An op that fills gaps to encourage connectivity; regions always grow fatter (they do not return to their original area). To keep the original size, apply hx_erosion1 with a similar radius downstream, or use hx_closing from the start. Outside the image is treated as 0 (dilation stops at the border). An empty region is returned empty.
